_meta: Per-emitter scale + spawn origin for every ParticleSystem in UILotteryCharacterAppear. canvas_origin_*_design_px is the emitter's centre in design-canvas coordinates (1920x1080); the css_y_design_px field flips Y for top-left origin. unit_px is the nearest UIParticle ancestor's m_Scale3D.x, falling back to 1.0 for ef_sageBg world-space emitters (their startSize values are already in design-pixel range).
